import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from fractions import Fraction
from counter import Counter
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_values(self):
        item = Counter()
        self.assertEqual(item.tags(), {'a', 'b'})
        self.assertEqual(item.blob(), b'xy')
        self.assertEqual(item.point().x, 3)
        self.assertTrue(item.has({'a'}))
        self.assertIs(item.same(), item)
        self.assertEqual(item.amount(), Decimal('1.50'))
        self.assertEqual(item.ratio(), Fraction(1, 3))
